name: Convert
summary: Convert pixel type (grayscale, RGB), bit depth (U8, U16), and resize with aspect-ratio letterboxing.

width.label: Target width (px, 0 = keep)
width.description: Output width in pixels. 0 retains source width.

height.label: Target height (px, 0 = keep)
height.description: Output height in pixels. 0 retains source height.

preserveRatio.label: Preserve aspect ratio (letterbox/pillarbox with black border)
preserveRatio.description: When true, scales proportionally and centers on a black canvas to fill dimensions.

colorMode.label: Color mode
colorMode.description: Color channel format (gray converts color to single-channel luminance).

depthMode.label: Bit depth
depthMode.description: Bit depth per channel: u8 (0..255) or u16 (0..65535).
